name: Doki Doki! RainClouds
source:
"For as long as I can remember, it's always been this way.
I've always been acting fake. Smiling at everybody, always trying my best to make sure everyone's happy and in good health. And in the meantime, I never really cared about myself."

Maybe what happened to Sayori was meant to be. Or maybe it wasn't. So there's a little hope... Just a little hope, that the rainclouds may go away.

[From [url=https://www.cykadev.com/rainclouds/]CykaDev Website[/url]]
